review.images: Reviewed the exact official project gallery and wide hero. Removed one narrower version of the same scene. The listing and interior images show the development’s published design.
review.location: Checked the named official project point and regional marina map independently. Visually verified five published launch estimates on the original Emaar fact sheet, credited to Petkovic Properties.
review.floorPlans: All 44 source pages were visually reviewed. The 40 residence drawings include 36 apartment and four townhouse sheets covering eight townhouses. Of the 51 area panels, the Building 2 Type 1G group on physical page 5 has a 0.10 sq ft printed total discrepancy. Checked the original source bytes and matched imperial area figures against independent PDFium text and spatial area panels.

unavailable: A corrected Building 2 Type 1G area table or developer-hosted copies of the two complete plan packs were not verified.
Signed unit-specific area and building entrance coordinates were not verified.
